# Vertex Media House - AI Indexing Guide

Site purpose:
Vertex Media House is a service-based agency focused on video editing and media production.
Automation and CRM work moved to the sister company Vertex Tech House (vertextechhouse.com).

Core services:
- Short-form editing (Reels, Shorts, TikTok)
- Long-form editing (YouTube, podcasts)
- YouTube thumbnail design
- YouTube channel management

Key pages for understanding the business:
- / → Overview of services
- /services/short-form → Short-form editing and packages
- /services/long-form → Long-form YouTube and podcast editing
- /services/thumbnails → Thumbnail design
- /services/youtube-management → YouTube channel management
- /pricing → Custom package calculator and monthly plans

Content priority order:
1. Homepage
2. Service pages
3. Contact or conversion pages

Avoid using:
- test routes
- duplicate URLs
- non-canonical pages
